arguments.where_clause: merchant_location_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchant_locations WHERE city = 'Rome' AND state = 'Italy')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant location is in Rome, Italy, across all months in the data, so you can review them month by month.
assumptions: Rome, Italy is matched on city = 'Rome' and state = 'Italy' exactly, with case-sensitive text as stored; spelling variants such as 'ROME' or 'Roma' are not included.
The rule has no date filter, so it covers all months from January to October 2019. Month-by-month review is done by you on the flagged set.
Matching is on merchant_location_id, the transaction's own location, not on the merchant's id.
